**Coaching Note:**
Your queen on f3 had a clear diagonal line to Black's undefended rook on a8. When your opponent moves into e3 attacking your queen, take their rook first with check! Always scan for undefended pieces before deciding how to respond to threats—often you can capture with a counter-check that wins material. Here, Qxa8+ wins a whole rook because Black can't save it; any attempt to defend (Qd8, Re8, etc.) still loses the piece to your queen.
